text.en: Clients describe remarkable behavioural progress in headstrong or reactive dogs after completing residential training programmes. Reviewers note that pets return with dependable obedience under distraction, loose-lead manners, and reliable protection capabilities that transform daily family living.

Dog owners praise Ash, Meg, and the Trident team for their deep canine knowledge, professionalism, and commitment. Clients appreciate the team's hands-on coaching, extensive experience with protection breeds, and willingness to guide owners thoroughly through every stage of transition and handover.

Reviewers emphasize that trained protection dogs remain gentle, affectionate, and safe around children and other household pets. Clients appreciate that animals develop confidence and drive while maintaining a calm domestic temperament, functioning both as vigilant guardians and beloved family companions.

q.en: What training programmes does Trident Elite provide?

a.en: Trident offers residential obedience courses, reactivity rehabilitation, tracking, and family protection dog training.

q.en: Are family protection dogs safe around children?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that protection dogs integrate comfortably into households, displaying gentle manners with young children.

q.en: Do clients receive updates during residential dog courses?

a.en: Yes, owners highlight receiving regular video updates and detailed progress feedback throughout residential training stays.

q.en: Where is the Trident training facility located?

a.en: The training kennels are located along Birmingham Road in Water Orton, on the north-eastern edge of Birmingham.
